title: Escape From the Bloodkeep
description: This campaign features a complete collection of episodes exploring the story of 'Escape From the Bloodkeep', a gripping narrative about survival and adventure. Each episode delves deeper into the challenges faced by the protagonists as they navigate through treacherous landscapes and encounter formidable foes.

episodes.title: Welcome to the Dark Side
episodes.description: In the ash-choked plains of Gorgar, the heroes infiltrate the towering Blood Keep to seek answers from the Pool of Souls, only to find the Dark Oracle haunted by visions of a younger spirit at a fountain of blood. As they descend past the beast pits where the monstrous Bog Lord directs a feeding frenzy, the Oracle’s critical success reveals a prophecy that feels wrong and confusing rather than empowering. With the forces of light rallying against the Lord of Shadows, the party faces an impending doom that the spirits refuse to explain, leaving them to wonder if the vision is a warning or a trap.

episodes.title: Volcano of Violence
episodes.description: The party descends into the treacherous volcanic forge where O'nash forged the Circles of Eternal Chains, only to find themselves surrounded by high-elven warriors and a massive, glowing anvil. As the halflings and their spirit companion Kasara prepare to confront the elves and secure a path back to the Blood Keep, the party navigates a cavern filled with chains, lava, and a giant spider. With Galfast Hamhead lifting Drowva to rush forward against the overwhelming odds, the high elves charge in, leaving the fate of the crown and their friends hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: The Caged Elf and the Crown
episodes.description: The party stands amidst the ruins of the volcano with the heavy Anvil of Gogumoth, joined by the injured Galfast Hamhead and the surprisingly negotiable eagle John Feathers. Through arcane visions, they learn the anvil can bind souls to forge divine power, but the Door of Doom has fallen, allowing enemy armies to march freely across the lands. Now, as the spiders of the Vinguri gather to the interior of the volcano, the group must decide whether to sacrifice their immortal essence to reforging the weapon before the horde swarms them.

episodes.title: Airship Ambush
episodes.description: In the skies above Gorgor, the crew of the *Siren* braces for a massive aerial assault as Captain St. Vincent outlines new ship combat rules while eagles descend carrying a giant tree monster and the party's brother. After casting protective spells and taking heroic potions, the raging Barbarian Soapbar leaps from the crow's nest to intercept the descending enemies. Just as the brother declares the fight over, Soapbar lands a massive critical hit, leaving the fate of the flagship hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: Bloodlines and Lifelines
episodes.description: After the sky ship shatters mid-air, the party finds themselves plummeting through volcanic smoke as the remnants of their vessel disintegrate around them. Clinging to a floating spar while witnessing the dwarven warrior Bolrich fall to her death, the adventurers catch a fleeting glimpse of the allied forces gathering near the damaged Bloodkeep below. As they drift toward the ground amidst the chaos of the erupting volcano, a desperate attempt to save Marcus leaves the group hanging in the balance.

episodes.title: The Tomb of Ultimate Evil
episodes.description: In a desperate bid to save Leland Jr. from Olog's raw primal evil, the party races to secure blessings from spiritual statues while Olog's loyalist forces breach the gate. Chaos ensues as Leland entrusts the child to Lilith for safety, engaging in a frantic battle of stealth and rage against charging goblins and orcs. With the ritual finally complete, the heroes face a chilling realization that suggests they may have already embraced the darkness they sought to defeat.
